The bus emerged from the Backstreets into a rather quiet looking village.
巴士穿过后巷，进入了一个幽静的村庄。
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles
梅菲斯托费勒斯 内部

dataList.content:
The fog was still thick, and everything was still in that faded hue...
还是老样子，浓雾弥漫，颜色黯淡……

Even the occasional sightings of pedestrians had ceased. The very idea of color variation seemed like an alien concept here.
原本就稀稀落落的行人如今更难寻到踪迹，而现在连有颜色的物体都很难看见了。

All I see are orange-hued lights coming through the windows of misty, grey buildings. It was as though everyone decided to stay indoors for the day.
透过雾中所见的仅有灰色建筑中亮起的橙色灯光。好像每个人都在家中安静地、如同死亡一般地度过着时间。

I can’t even tell where we are, or how close we are from our destination anymore.
这样一来，我连这是哪里，我们到了哪里都分不清了。

<Have you been here by any chance, Yi Sang?>
<说不定你认识这里呢，李箱？>

He was the only other Sinner who had spent a while in T Corp., so I decided to ask if he recognized anything. But it was evident that this scenery was unfamiliar to him.
因为他是曾经在T公司待过的罪人，所以我如此询问道，但李箱以一副陌生的表情望着褪色的风景。

Though I have resided here for some time, most of my hours were spent earning a living and conducting my research when I could afford to do so. Thus I have not ventured freely the streets of T Corp.
我当时尽可能地不引人注目，埋头于研究与谋生。所以并没有怎么在T公司之中随心漫步。

<I can’t imagine doing any research at a place like this… Can’t have been easy.>
<一直在这种地方做研究，你一定很辛苦吧。>

It is quite manageable once one grows accustomed to this monochromatic sight. The presence of variance in color itself is a concept alien to those who are born and raised in these lands.
习惯后也就安稳了。反而对生于此处的他们来说，颜色才是不可思议之物。

And I had shoulders of those that I could… lean on, even for a fleeting moment. It helps to have such support when acclimating to a place as foreign as this.
而且我……身边曾有过可以暂时依靠的人。这对我适应陌生之处帮助良多。

Yi Sang looks away to a place far beyond from here. Memories of his past, most likely.
我可以感受到李箱的视线焦点越来越远。大概他是在回忆过往吧。

… Did you ever hear anything about what T Corp.’s Singularity is?
……你知道T公司的奇点是什么吗？

… As all Singularities are, its true nature, its mechanisms, and function are all something of an enigma. Yet...
关于那个……和惯常一样，我也无法正确推断奇点的作用原理。只是……

Yi Sang paused, and carefully began to speak.
李箱慎重地开口道。

I am aware is that it has aught to do with time. Though I am unsure of its use...
我知晓那与时间有关。虽然不清楚他们具体是以怎样的形式，如何操纵时间的……

Well, I suppose all this is but meaningless conjecture, and only Miss Faust among us must be aware of the answers.
不过，这也只是一种无意义的推测，答案恐怕只有浮士德女士知晓。

Its singularity is one of the reasons T Corp. constantly drains colors from its inhabitants.
这也是T公司不断夺取其居民颜色的理由之一。

What’s time got to do with… color?
这和颜色……又有什么关系？

If the control of time is so imperative to T Corp.'s operations... then they must also control the realm of ‘light’.
若是在时间必须受到操纵的区域内……他们就必定也掌握着“光”的相关领域。

As light inherently has much to do with the spectrum of colors, these two subjects eventually overlap.
鉴于光和颜色本身有着密切的关系，这两者最终会交织在一起。

That is as far as I could deduce regarding the concept of time that I am aware of. Yet, it must also be said that it takes time for me to reach Faust’s specific knowledge regarding T Corp.’s Singularity.
……以上是从我知晓的时间相关概念所推论出的可能性，另外补充一句，我还需要更多的时间以接触浮士德所持有的T公司奇点相关知识。

Faust, known among us for her ‘Hm.’, ‘Maybe.’, and ‘Perhaps.’… rarely ever gave us answers this detailed.
一般只会回答“嗯”“是的”“也可以这么说”的浮士德很少会给出如此详细的回答。

Then now’s the time to ask her all my questions…!
那就趁这个机会……

Miss Faust, as we discuss the subject of time—
浮士德女士，如果是时间的话……

Indeed. It would be safe for us to move on from the subject of T Corp. at this time.
是的，有关T公司的话题在这里结束会比较安全。

There she goes again, teasing us with stuff she’s not going to tell us anyway...
又是先假装要告诉我们什么东西，然后突然闭口不谈……

Well, I guess I should be glad that she decided to tell us this much. I doubt she'll tell us more no matter how much we pry.
罢了，就算纠缠不休她也不会说的吧……能听到这么多我已经很满足了。

That’s… kinda sad.
但是……那有点让人难过呢。

That there are people who’s never seen color their whole lives, all because of this Singularity.
因为奇点，也有一辈子都不知道颜色存在的人吧……

Well, that’s just how it goes, isn't it. In the eyes of a stranger, we’d be just another one of those poor, miserable people who’s never seen color.
哎呀~大家都一样啦。在别人看来，我们或许也是一群生活在无知中的可怜人呢。

That's the danger in trying your very first bite of the 'meat'. You taste it once, and you’ll never un-know the flavor. And in the end, you’ll start to wish you never tried it.
不管怎么说，记住第一口肉的味道是很恐怖的。如果能一辈子不知道地过下去就算了……但一旦知道肉的味道，就再也无法回到从前了。

Hm… It is pretty disappointing that even the sun loses its vibrancy here.
嗯……连阳光的颜色都看不到也太可惜了。

Oft did I long to see the colors of the sky. Especially the sky that looms over a light shower of rain.
我多有怀念天穹色彩的时刻。特别是细雨飘落之时。

Yeah. Things like the color of the sky, too. You long to see it only because you've seen its beauty. If you were born here, never to escape its borders to the last of your days without ever seeing the blue sky... then I'd hardly call that death miserable.
是，这种情况也是……因为各位知晓天空的颜色，所以才会感到悲伤，感到怀念。如果从最初开始就看着这片天空由生至死，那也不是什么不幸的事情吧。

Calling even that miserable... is nothing but sheltered arrogance.
如果连这都被称之为不幸，那反倒是一种傲慢了。

I guess that could also be true...
好像也可以这么想呢……

The atmosphere in the bus suddenly became incredibly frosty.
突然，巴士中的气氛陷入了冰点。

Oh! Hey, speaking of color, I got something to ask ya. Have you guys ever heard of the ‘colors game’? Apparently, each type of personality has a corresponding color!
啊！来试试那个吧。根据一个人最喜欢的颜色可以明白他的性格。

Rodya, who was the one to chill the bus in the first place, was also the first to break the ice.
然后让气氛冻结的罗佳立刻打破了沉寂。

If Yi Sang enjoys the light blue color of the sky, then… Let’s see. You must be a thinker and a philosopher who prefers the calm and quiet.
李箱喜欢天蓝色代表的是……让我看看，平稳而安静的你……喜欢沉浸于思考之中。

Ooh… How did you come to know that? That is quite the remarkable talent you have.
哦……你是如何知晓的？这真是个奇特的才能。

Hark, hark! I wish my favorite color to be rated as well! Forsooth, I quite fancy the color red! Nay, yellow! Nay, red! Nay—
吾！也拜托测测吾的！那个，吾喜欢红色！不对不对是黄色！不对，红色！不对不对……

Now, wait your turn. Next in the order is… Faust.
来，排好队等着。下一个是浮士德……

I—
我……

Wait up, wait up. I know exactly what you’re about to say. You were about to say, ‘Faust does not hold much belief in such ideations~’ or something like that, right?
等等等等。我知道你想要说什么。“浮士德不怎么相信这样的东西~”，对吧？

Which is exactly what people who like the color white would say. I'm right, aren't I? Like, your hair’s white, too!
这样的人一般都喜欢白色。对吧？就和你的发色一样。

I will not comment further on this subject.
我不对此多做评价。

… Me? My favourite colour…?
……我？最喜欢的……颜色？

Tsk, what a stupid question. That's naff, lass.
真是的，干嘛问那种问题。太尴尬了。

But I like…
我的话……

He pauses.
希斯克利夫瞬间僵住了。

A great manor begins to emerge into our view from a distance. I could immediately tell that this was the ‘Wuthering Heights’ manor Heathcliff had mentioned.
从远处可以望见巨大的宅邸。一眼便知，那是希斯克利夫所说的被叫做“呼啸山庄”的地方。

... black.
黑色。

It’s the colour you get when you dump an entire set of paint into a bucket, innit?
那是把所有的颜料都混在一起就能调出的颜色吧。

And that’s exactly why I tolerate it. Keep throwing paint over paint over paint… and you get black. Simple.
所以那是最耐看的颜色。只要反复在上面涂抹颜料就行了。

I can clearly hear that Heathcliff is muttering through gritted teeth.
我能听见希斯克利夫的臼齿摩擦的声音。

I have a feeling that black wasn’t always his favorite color.
……我能感到希斯克利夫并不是从一开始就喜欢黑色。
